content: प्रमद् €4 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To be intoxicated or drunk. .²2 To be careless about, to be negligent or heedless, be regardless of or indifferent to (with <ab>loc.</ab>); अतोऽर्थान्न प्रमाद्यन्ति प्रमदासु विपश्चितः <ls>Ms. 2. 213</ls>. .²3 To omit to do, swerve or deviate from (with <ab>abl.</ab>); स्वाधिकारात् प्रमत्तः <ls>Me. 1</ls>. .²4 To make a mistake, err, go astray; प्रमाद्यन् चारदुर्बलः <ls>Bk. 5. 8</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">17. 39</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">18. 8</ls>. .²5 To spend or while away (time). .²6 To be joyous; युक्तः प्रमाद्यसि हितादपेतः परितप्यसे <ls>Ki. 11. 29</ls>.
